findings.description: gate_decision keeps completed_prior=4 as a default, i.e. the most permissive value, so any future caller that forgets the argument silently restores the weakened fifth-attempt path the attempt-02 finding closed. validate_review (review_phase.py:186) already calls gate_decision without it; that is currently harmless because verify_record independently recomputes the decision with the real count (245-248) and a rejected record cannot carry gate_passed true, but the safe default is the strict one. Relatedly, verify_attempt_sequence reads a previous attempt's prompt/checks evidence through sha256(evidence) (102-105) and json.loads(path.read_text()) (107) without an is_file() guard, so a deleted prior artifact raises FileNotFoundError out of the CLI instead of the fail-closed ValueError used everywhere else in that function.
findings.required_fix: Make completed_prior keyword-required (or default it to 0) and pass it explicitly from validate_review's caller chain, and add an is_file() check before each previous-attempt artifact read in verify_attempt_sequence so a missing prompt, checks snapshot or record raises "Previous review evidence has changed" rather than an unhandled OSError.

findings.description: A chunk's declared scope_evidence is mutable, unversioned bookkeeping: this chunk's declaration grew from four paths (as recorded in docs/reviews/phase-21-chunk-phase-governance-attempt-02.json:89-94) to the eight paths now at docs/phase-status.json:5050-5058, with no record that attempts 01-02 reviewed a narrower scope. The expansion was justified here (the high finding required the CI artifacts in scope), but verify_record checks a record against the current declaration via matches_declared_scope (267), while verify_attempt_sequence does not check earlier attempts' scope at all (107-122). So earlier accepted chunk records can be retroactively invalidated by a later edit, and a declaration can be narrowed after acceptance without any artifact showing the change. The scope lives in docs/phase-status.json, which fingerprint() excludes (review_phase.py:16), so no source hash binds it.
findings.required_fix: Record the declared scope history per attempt: keep a scope_evidence_sha256 or an explicit revision list in the chunk declaration, require verify_attempt_sequence to confirm each prior record's scope_evidence matches the declaration revision in force at that attempt, and add a regression test in tools/test_management_phases.py that narrowing or rewriting a declaration after an accepted chunk review fails rather than silently re-binding it.
